title: Quick shell change without manually logging out and back in again (under the same user account)
line: General Behavior settings can now switch Plasma to another installed workspace, such as Bigscreen, without logging out.
explanation: Plasma 6.4 gained org.kde.PlasmaShell.changeShell, which swaps the running shell package and reloads its own layout, but nothing in the UI used it, so switching from Desktop to Bigscreen or Mobile still meant logging out and choosing another session. The KCM now lists installed workspace shells (those with X-Plasma-APIVersion, which leaves out Plasma Nano and the plasmoidviewer shell) as a “Workspace type” combo box in General Behavior, shown only when more than one is installed. Applying writes [Shell] ShellPackage in plasmashellrc (so it survives a plasmashell restart and the next login; Defaults removes it and goes back to the session's PLASMA_DEFAULT_SHELL) and calls changeShell so the switch happens immediately.

commits.message:
kcms/workspace: add a setting to switch the workspace type

Switching between Plasma Desktop and another shell such as Bigscreen
meant logging out and picking a different session. Plasma can now change
shells live, so offer the installed ones here and switch when applied.

BUG: 470519

media.caption: Master, with a second shell installed: General Behavior has no way to switch shells.
With the fix: a Workspace type combo box lists the installed shells.
Test Workspace picked, before pressing Apply: still the Desktop shell.
After Apply: Plasma switched to the other shell live (its own panel and wallpaper), no logout.
